analytics_lengths.name: analytics_lengths
analytics_lengths.value: char_length("analytics_events"."path") <= 200 AND ("analytics_events"."value" IS NULL OR char_length("analytics_events"."value") <= 100) AND ("analytics_events"."referrer_host" IS NULL OR char_length("analytics_events"."referrer_host") <= 100) AND ("analytics_events"."category" IS NULL OR char_length("analytics_events"."category") <= 40) AND ("analytics_events"."visitor" IS NULL OR "analytics_events"."visitor" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')

listings_subcategory_len.name: listings_subcategory_len
listings_subcategory_len.value: "listings"."subcategory" IS NULL OR char_length("listings"."subcategory") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

listings_moderation_note_len.name: listings_moderation_note_len
listings_moderation_note_len.value: "listings"."moderation_note" IS NULL OR char_length("listings"."moderation_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

staff_display_name_len.name: staff_display_name_len
staff_display_name_len.value: "staff_users"."display_name" IS NULL OR char_length("staff_users"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

users_profile_banner_len.name: users_profile_banner_len
users_profile_banner_len.value: "users"."profile_banner" IS NULL OR char_length("users"."profile_banner") BETWEEN 1 AND 20
